items.summary: The charge call has no idempotency key, so a retry or double click charges the card twice.
items.fix: Send an Idempotency-Key derived from the order, and record attempts in a table with a unique constraint.

items.summary: Charge state is whatever the synchronous call returned. No webhook handler exists, so refunds, disputes and async failures are invisible.
items.fix: Add a signature-verified webhook endpoint and treat it as the source of truth.
